source_integrity_notes.note: Several source entries are OCR-truncated in the uploaded file. Recoverable mechanics are preserved; missing printed values are omitted rather than inferred.
Notably affected entries include Mule, Neanderthal, Ogre, Manticore, and some leader/lair detail lines broken by image markers.

stat_block.attacks: 3 or 1 (2 claws and 1 bite, or weapon)

population_rules.rule: Females fight as gnolls.
Eggs do not fight.
Village encounters have a 75% chance of a shaman and a 50% chance of a witch doctor.
Shaman uses sub-chieftain statistics and has Clerical abilities of level 1d6.
Witch doctor uses champion statistics and has Mage abilities of level 1d4.

attack_routine.name: weapon_attack
attack_routine.notes: Common weapons include spiked clubs, javelins, and barbed darts.

attack_effect.effect: Treat barbed darts as daggers when thrown.

ability.name: leader_statistics
ability.effect: Champion: AC 5, HD 3+1, 17 hp, +1 damage with natural attacks, +2 with weapons. Sub-chieftain: AC 6, HD 4+1, 21 hp, +2 damage with natural attacks, +3 with weapons. Chieftain: AC 7, HD 6+2, 30 hp, +2 damage with natural attacks, +3 with weapons.

ability.name: glide
ability.effect: Capable of gliding due to large skin flaps below its limbs.

habitat.rule: Lives primarily above ground but may venture underground for shelter or food.

mobility_rules.rule: Adept at walking sheer cliffs and upside down.
May spring on prey from above.

attack_effect.trigger: Special attack available in addition to ordinary attacks described in text.
attack_effect.effect: Reaches 5'; on a successful attack the victim is yanked to the mouth and bitten without requiring another attack throw.
On a successful attack the opponent is knocked down and may not attack that round.

ability.name: camouflage
ability.effect: Characters encountering it suffer a -3 penalty to surprise rolls.

ability.name: membrane_infravision
ability.effect: Has infravision to 90' when it lowers a special membrane-like eyelid over each eye.

attack_effect.effect: May occur when panicked locusts flee into a group; only half of panic flights are toward the group, and a successful attack inflicts slam damage.

attack_effect.to_hit_rule: Attack throw is always against AC 0 because the effect occurs even if armor is not bypassed.
attack_effect.effect: Range 10'. Incapacitation lasts 1 turn; after that, the target becomes immune to the odor.
attack_effect.follow_up: Spittle must be rinsed off. Any creature coming within 5' of a spit-soaked creature must save vs Poison or be wracked with vomiting.

mobility_rules.rule: When sensing disturbance, typically jumps up to 60' away in panic.

ability.name: shriek
ability.effect: All cavern locusts in a group shriek when disturbed, attracting wandering monsters.

procedure.name: wandering_monster_attraction
procedure.condition: One or more cavern locusts are attacking.

steps.step: Roll an encounter throw each round.
If wandering monsters are indicated, they arrive in 1d4 rounds.
Locusts jump up to 60' away in a haphazard direction.
Half the time they flee toward the group.
If a successful attack throw is made, a creature struck takes 1d4 slam damage.

special_defense.name: animal_form_weapon_immunity
special_defense.effect: In animal form, immune to all attacks from normal weapons; can be harmed by spells, silver, and enchanted weapons.

ability.name: shapechange
ability.effect: Takes human form and one specific animal form.
ability.notes: Lycanthropes never wear armor because it hinders shapechanging.

ability.name: summon_animals
ability.effect: Can summon 1d2 animals of the same type; they appear in 1d4 rounds.

ability.name: wolfsbane_ward
ability.trigger: Touched by wolfsbane, whether thrown or otherwise used to hit.

ability.name: death_reversion
ability.effect: When killed, a lycanthrope takes human form.

ability.name: animal_sense
ability.effect: Horses and other domestic animals sense nearby lycanthropes and become restless or bolt.

ability.name: form_rules
ability.effect: In animal form, may communicate only with animals of its type and may not speak humanoid language.

procedure.name: lycanthropy_infection
procedure.condition: A creature loses 50% or more of total hit points to a lycanthrope's claws and bite.

steps.step: Victim contracts lycanthropy of the attacker's type.
Several days before full onset, victim begins showing secondary animal characteristics.

procedure.outcome: Humans become lycanthropes; demi-humans and other humanoids die after 2d6 days instead.

steps.step: If one parent is a lycanthrope, child has a 50% chance to become a lycanthrope at puberty.
If both parents are lycanthropes, chance is 100%.
If the parents are different lycanthrope types, determine the child's type randomly between parental types.
Cure disease removes lycanthropy only if cast before the disease fully takes hold.
Inherited lycanthropy can never be cured.

attack_effect.trigger: If both claws hit in the same round.
attack_effect.effect: May grab opponent in a crushing hug.

social_structure.rule: Tends to be solitary; may occasionally live with normal bears.

ability.name: enrage
ability.effect: When enraged, gains +2 to attack throws and continues fighting until all enemies are gone or it is killed.

ability.name: ratman_form
ability.effect: May assume an intermediate ratman form.
ability.notes: In ratman form, may use weapons and humanoid speech while retaining animal-form immunity to natural weapons and ability to communicate with rats.

ability.name: stealth
ability.effect: Characters encountering wererats suffer a -2 penalty to surprise rolls.

ability.name: stealth
ability.effect: Characters encountering weretigers suffer a -2 penalty to surprise rolls.

population_rules.rule: A pack of at least 5 includes a pack leader.

ability.name: pack_leader
ability.effect: Pack leader fights as a 5 HD monster, has 30 hit points, and gains +2 damage.

attack_effect.effect: Can throw 6 spikes per round, including while airborne; range 180'.

ability.name: spike_regrowth
ability.effect: Regrows 2 spikes per day.

references.notation_reference: Printed damage line is absent in the uploaded source; only explicit spike damage is preserved.

mobility_rules.rule: When distance permits, may charge with tusk attacks for double damage.

targeting_constraints.constraint: Trample attack receives +4 to attack throw against man-sized or smaller opponents.

special_defense.name: magical_save_progression
special_defense.effect: Saves as a 7 Hit Dice monster despite only having 4 Hit Dice.

ability.name: disguise
ability.effect: May disguise itself with a hooded robe before revealing its true nature.

treasure_rules.rule: Half of lair treasure is likely on petrified victims and is only accessible if the victims are restored to flesh.

ability.name: common_rules
ability.effect: All men in this entry are considered 1st level fighters. Individuals of greater level typically lead them.
ability.notes: Treasure types indicate treasure found in lairs, except for merchants and pirates. Leaders or other leveled characters may also possess magic items; for each item category, there is a 5% chance per leader level that the leader possesses one of that category.

population_rules.rule: Warband leader is a 4th level fighter with Berserkergang proficiency.

ability.name: battle_rage
ability.effect: +2 to attack value and fights fearlessly until killed.

member.number: 1 level-4 fighter and 2 level-2 fighters per band

population_rules.rule: Camp is led by a 9th level brigand captain.
Camp has one 5th level lieutenant per 2 bands.
Camp has a 30% chance of an 8th level cleric and a 50% chance of a mage of level 8+1d2.

ability.name: equipment_split
ability.effect: 50% use short sword, short bow, leather armor, and shield; 50% use long swords, chainmail, shields, and light warhorses.

ability.name: leader_equipment
ability.effect: Band leaders use long swords, lances, plate armor, and medium warhorses with chain barding.

population_rules.rule: 70% are chaotic buccaneers that attack any ship.
30% are neutral privateers that attack only ships sailing under enemy flags.
Fleet size and treasure depend on ship type as shown on the pirate_fleet table.
Number of pirates encountered is determined by ship crew requirements and includes full complements of marines, rowers, and sailors.

attack_effect.effect: All pirates are armed with swords and leather armor; 40% also carry crossbows or short bows.

ability.name: crew_composition
ability.effect: Marines and sailors are always pirates. Rowers on riverboats and longships are pirates. Rowers on galleys are captive slaves. Slaves are never armed and do not fight.

ability.name: officer_distribution
ability.effect: For every 30 pirates, one 4th level fighter is present. For every 50 pirates, one 5th level fighter is present. There are 1d4 hostages per 50 pirates.

ability.name: fleet_command
ability.effect: Fleets under 200 are led by an 8th level pirate captain. Fleets of 200 or more are led by an 11th level pirate king. Pirate kings always have a first mate of 8th level and have a 75% chance of employing a mage of level 8+1d2.

ability.name: treasure_map
ability.effect: When encountered away from the lair, the pirate captain or king has a treasure map to the lair's location.

social_structure.rule: Pirate lairs are remote islands where plunder is buried.

population_rules.rule: Caravans consist of 10-40 large wagons.
Each wagon is drawn by four heavy draft horses.
For every 10 wagons, there are 5 merchants on medium riding horses.
For every 10 wagons, 20 level-1 fighters led by 2 level-3 fighters defend the caravan.
Every caravan has a guard captain who is a 5th level fighter on a medium warhorse.

ability.name: equipment
ability.effect: Merchants wear chainmail and carry crossbows and daggers. Guards wear chainmail and carry swords, crossbows, and daggers. Guard captain wears plate armor and carries sword, crossbow, and dagger.

population_rules.rule: Each caravan is led by one 4th level fighter and two 2nd level fighters.
Camp is ruled by an 8th level chieftain.
Camp has one 5th level elite guard for every four caravans.
Camp has a 50% chance of a 9th level cleric and a 25% chance of an 8th level mage.
Camp has a 70% chance of protection by 4d6 trained hunting dogs.
Camp has adult noncombatants and young equal to 100% and 200% of able-bodied adults, respectively.

ability.name: equipment
ability.effect: Nomads wear leather 50%, chain 30%, or lamellar 20%; all carry short swords and daggers. Half also carry composite bows and ride light riding horses; half carry lances and ride light warhorses. Leaders carry both lance and bow, wear lamellar, and ride light warhorses.

behavior_rules.rule: Often trades with humans and demi-humans; almost always clashes with beastmen.

member.number: 1 leader with 2 Hit Dice per band
1 exceptional leader with 4 Hit Dice per village

population_rules.rule: Village has a 70% chance of protection by 3d6 giant fish.
Villages are usually guarded by 3d6 giant rockfish.

behavior_rules.rule: Tracks enemies it loses sight of with a proficiency throw of 18+.

population_rules.rule: Lair has a 75% chance of protection by 3d6 trained white apes.

ability.name: daylight_penalty
ability.effect: If caught in daylight, suffers -2 to attack throws.

ability.name: leader_statistics
ability.effect: Champion: AC 2, HD 1+1, 8 hp. Sub-chieftain: AC 3, HD 2, 12 hp, +1 damage. Chieftain: AC 4, HD 3, 15 hp, +2 damage.

ability.name: infravision
ability.effect: Has infravision to 90'.

behavior_rules.rule: Only ventures to the surface at night.
Enemies of neanderthals, dwarves, and gnomes; may join orcs and goblins.

steps.step: May be taken into a dungeon to transport equipment or treasure.
This is only possible so long as conditions allow.

ability.name: mummy_rot

ability.notes: While affected, the target cannot benefit from any magical healing and heals naturally at 1/10 normal rate. Remove curse removes mummy rot.

population_rules.rule: Lair has a 75% chance of protection by 3d6 trained white apes.

ability.name: leader_statistics
ability.effect: Champion: AC 2, HD 3, 15 hp. Chieftain: HD 6 and +2 bonus to damage rolls.

behavior_rules.rule: Reveres cave bears and hunts them for rites of passage and religious purposes.
Despises kobolds, goblins, and morlocks; enjoys the company of gnomes and dwarves.

ability.name: tree_bound_life
ability.effect: Bound to a particular tree; if the tree is killed, the dryad dies.

ability.name: tree_merge
ability.effect: May physically join with the tree and effectively disappear.

ability.name: range_limit
ability.effect: May not venture more than 240' from the tree; dies after 1 turn if beyond that distance.

ability.name: charm

save.on_failure: goes to the dryad's tree and disappears within it

ability.effect: Any individual who enters the tree this way is lost forever.

social_structure.rule: Usually solitary; up to six may rarely be encountered together.

treasure_rules.rule: Groves often accumulate treasure from past victims or infatuations and store it underground at the base of the tree.

save.on_failure: taken into the naiad's watery domain to serve for 12 months

ability.name: water_breathing
ability.effect: May cast water breathing at will on a character.

ability.name: summon_giant_bass
ability.effect: May fight with very small weapons or summon a giant bass for protection.
ability.notes: Giant bass: AL N, MV 120' (40'), AC 2, HD 2, #AT 1, Dmg 1d6, Save F1, ML 0.

attack_effect.effect: After 1 round, acid eats through cloth, wood, and leather but not stone or metal.

mobility_rules.rule: Has no fixed form and can squeeze under doors and into other small spaces.

ability.name: division
ability.effect: Divides into 1d3+2 smaller amoebas with 2 Hit Dice each.
ability.notes: Smaller jellies deal 1d6 damage to flesh and suffer no further effects from lightning or weapons.

ability.name: elemental_interaction
ability.effect: Fire and cold damage an ochre jelly normally.

attack_effect.damage: 1d3 per tentacle each round after a successful attack
attack_effect.effect: Tentacles constrict victims; each constricting tentacle imposes a cumulative -1 attack penalty.
attack_effect.follow_up: Example given: four constricting tentacles inflict 4d3 damage per round and impose -4 to attack throws.

attack_effect.effect: A tentacle can be cut off if a single blow inflicts 6 or more damage.

mobility_rules.rule: When fleeing, moves at triple speed: 270' per round.

ability.name: ink_cloud
ability.effect: Sprays a 40' radius cloud of black ink to obscure retreat.
